title: Super Supportive · Episode 23 · 压扁的面包
description: Connie leaves a note. Alden tries to reason his fear away, but a bag of groceries and a pair of tiger shorts make an ordinary evening harder.

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca, Chapter 8
sources.note: Verified homecoming passage from dark mood through Connie’s chaos. Ends before the cat arrives.

planning.sourceBoundary: Pinned Chapter 8 homecoming through tiger shorts, before mewing at front door.
planning.storytellingVoice: Intimate character drama: an absent guardian and everyday objects expose fear beneath anger.
planning.desire: Get through an ordinary evening without being overwhelmed.
planning.obstacle: Connie has left again; memories of threatened foster care defeat rational reassurance.
planning.earlyCare: He comes home already unhappy to find he must care for himself again.
planning.dramaticChange: Reasoning secures his practical future but cannot make the present neglect feel small.
planning.payoff: The crushed bread and absurd shorts reveal how thin his usual tolerance has become.
planning.continuingQuestion: Why can he not let Connie’s chaos pass around him tonight?

opening.moment: Alden protests Connie’s note alone in the kitchen
opening.speaker: Alden

continuation.end: Alden returns to Connie’s California note. Fear of being taken into care resurfaces; he reasons that money and approaching sixteen may protect his independence. Crushed bread, an unpaid electric bill, dirty cups and unfamiliar tiger-striped shorts defeat his attempts to stay calm. Stops before Victor arrives; no phone call or funeral decision.
continuation.nextStart: There was a mewing sound at the front door,
continuation.nextEndBefore: No way am I going to sleep anytime soon.
continuation.note: Victor arrives. Alden searches for missing cat food, suspects Connie or tiger-shorts owner, texts her twice without reply and feeds Victor bologna. Stop before the hard phone call; do not yet decide the funeral.

artwork.format: Three equal 2-column by 3-row sheets; 17 selected panels cover 41 passages.
promptSet: Evening kitchen: arrival, refrigerator note, note detail, hurt protest, discarded note, calming breath. Ink and soft gouache; varied wide, over-shoulder, close and profile shots.
Practical reassurance, counting resources, younger Alden questioned by male neighbor in soft-edged memory, empty-home vacation gesture, fridge viewpoint, juice bottles pressing bread.
Crushed bread detail (rejected; reused sheet 2 panel 6), comically affronted face, fried bologna, electricity bill and dirty mugs, tiger-striped shorts, tired quiet closeup.
Opening: layered textured cut-paper collage, Alden holding crumpled note in indigo kitchen and amber refrigerator light.
artwork.corrections: Corrected memory neighbor to a man; excluded inaccurate bread insert. No source text or lettering in images.
